text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho is finally here! Vodka and 
Daiwa Scarlet both seem to be in peak 
condition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Aston Machan felt lightheaded 
and floaty... Her condition remained poor 
as ever, but she clearly had no intention 
of surrendering victory.
